transcript.answer:
## Results

**Czech Wikipedia** has a dedicated article on intermittent fasting ("Přerušovaný půst"), and interest is **declining significantly**:

- **Trend**: Down 47.7% over the last 12 months (Sept 2025–Aug 2026 vs Sept 2024–Aug 2025)
- **Confidence**: Medium
- **90% range**: -62.5% to -27.9%
- **Monthly views**: ~146 views/month
- **Pattern**: Decline is consistent—11 of 12 months showed fewer views than the same months a year earlier
- **Note**: Some spike days occurred (April 14 and August 15, 2025; October 17, 2024), but without them the decline would be -34.4%

**Polish Wikipedia** has **no dedicated article** on intermittent fasting. To compare, I can use a broader proxy article like "Post" (fasting in general, Q44602) or "Dieta" (diet, Q474191), which would measure interest in fasting/diet more broadly rather than intermittent fasting specifically.

**Would you like me to analyze Polish Wikipedia using one of these proxy articles?** If so, I can compare the actual Polish interest in fasting/diet concepts against the Czech intermittent fasting data. Keep in mind the proxy would measure something slightly different—interest in fasting or diet generally, not intermittent fasting specifically.
